verdict.rationale: Proton documents an official Proton Pass CLI. It does full CRUD on vaults and items, injects secrets into scripts and CI/CD pipelines without exposing plaintext, manages shared-vault permissions, and runs in headless environments. That covers the core of an official CLI usable in automated, agent-driven workflows. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, explicit documentation of AI-agent-oriented features (e.g., machine-readable/JSON output or agent integration guidance)

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: the CLI enables you to securely retrieve secrets and other items across scripts, deployments, and continuous integration/ continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines.
View, create, update, and delete items including passwords, secure notes, credit cards, identities, WiFi entries, custom items, and stored SSH-key items
With Proton Pass CLI, credentials can be injected directly into scripts, deployments, and CI/CD pipelines without exposing secrets in plaintext, shell, logs, or command history.
Work in CI/CD, servers, containers, and headless environments
Create, read, update, and delete vaults
